svg.text: Craft overseer: far away, one ender chest pair

g.text: an ender chest pair, its own colours

svg.text: + wired modem on its own cable
each turtle's barrel, directly in front of it
with a wired modem on the site's cable
• Keep the crafting site loaded (a chunk loader), or its turtles stop answering.
• Use the linkable kind of ender chest (EnderStorage): a vanilla one can't be seen by computers.
